international.title: Trump proposing new tariffs on 14 partners including China and European Union
international.summary: The administration is suggesting an added 20% tax on Chinese imports, which would bring the total to about 40% US politics live – latest updates Donald Trump is proposing new tariffs on 14 trading partners, including China and the European Union, that would go into effect early next year, the office of the US trade representative said onWednesday. The administration is proposing an additional 20% tax on Chinese imports, which would bring the total tax to around 40%. Other countries impacted by the new tariffs include Bangladesh, ‌Cambodia, the European Union, India, Indonesia, Japan, South Korea, Malaysia, Singapore, Switzerland, Taiwan, Thailand and Vietnam.
